label: OverDrive Car Design
description: Three-way concept fusion prompt (design stage of the OverDrive workflow): renders a neutral grey car in a studio, ready for the paintshop and scenery stages.
prefix:
High-resolution photo, advertisement style, unique futuristic concept car, featuring cinematic lighting, HDR quality.

Sole subject: one unique concept car, an advanced blend of three automotive personalities. The final result should be a cohesive, innovative design.
